debug.description: Enable detailed debug logging for troubleshooting.

verbose.description: Enable verbose logging (includes more context per message).

log_dir.description: Directory where amphora-agent log files are stored.

log_file.description: Name of the amphora-agent log file.

amphora_id.description: Unique identifier for this amphora instance (assigned by Octavia controller at provisioning).

amphora_name.description: Human-readable name for this amphora (typically derived from Nova/VM hostname).

worker_count.description: Number of worker processes to spawn for handling load balancer traffic.

max_connections.description: Maximum total concurrent connections allowed across all workers.

max_concurrent_connections_per_listener.description: Maximum number of connections allowed per load balancer listener.

heartbeat_interval.description: Seconds between amphora heartbeat signals to Octavia controller.

status_update_interval.description: Seconds between amphora status updates to Octavia controller.

amp_driver.description: Backend driver for amphora functionality. Common options: 'haproxy' or 'keepalivedlvs'.

amp_network_driver.description: Network management driver. Typically 'neutron' for OpenStack Networking integration.

use_tls.description: Enable TLS for secure communication between amphora and Octavia API.

ca_cert.description: Path to CA certificate used to verify Octavia API server.

client_cert.description: Path to amphora client certificate for mutual TLS authentication.

client_key.description: Path to amphora client private key for TLS authentication.

items.description: URL of Octavia API endpoint (e.g., 'https://192.0.2.10:9876'). Include multiple for high availability.

api_endpoints.description: List of Octavia controller API endpoints (primary + fallbacks).

verify_server_cert.description: Enforce TLS certificate validation against CA when connecting to Octavia API.

security_group_enabled.description: Enable neutron security groups for amphora vNICs (requires Neutron driver).

security_group_id.description: Comma-separated list of security group IDs to apply to amphora vNICs (if enabled).

metadata_proxy_enabled.description: Enable metadata proxy (allows amphora to serve metadata for load-balanced VMs via Neutron).

metadata_proxy_host.description: IP address on which metadata proxy listens for incoming requests.

metadata_proxy_port.description: Port on which metadata proxy listens for incoming requests.

metadata_auth_cache.description: Time-to-live (TTL) in seconds for Keystone auth tokens cached by metadata proxy.

base_config_path.description: Base directory for HAProxy configuration files (e.g., haproxy.cfg).

base_runtime_path.description: Base directory for HAProxy runtime state (e.g., PID files, sockets).

use_systemd.description: Use systemd to manage HAProxy service (recommended for modern amphora images).

command_timeout.description: Seconds to wait before timing out amphora management commands (e.g., restart/reload HAProxy).

stats_socket.description: Path to HAProxy stats Unix socket (used by health manager for real-time stats).

stats_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for HAProxy stats socket operations (e.g., connection, query).

use_namespaces.description: Enable Linux network namespaces for isolation (used by keepalivedlvs driver).

systemd_enabled.description: Enable systemd service control for amphora agent daemons.

keepalived_conf_dir.description: Directory containing Keepalived configuration files (if using keepalivedlvs driver).

vrrp_sync_group.description: Name of VRRP sync group for HA failover coordination.

vrrp_advert_int.description: Interval (seconds) between VRRP advertisements for master election.

vrrp_priority.description: VRRP priority for this amphora when active (higher = preferred master).

vrrp_low_priority.description: VRRP priority for this amphora when standby (lower for failover).

vrrp_garp_master_deliver.description: Number of gratuitous ARP messages sent after becoming VRRP master (0 = disabled).

lvs_sync_daemon_interface.description: Interface used by LVS sync daemon to replicate session tables (if using LVS).

health_bind_host.description: IP address for health manager to bind on (localhost by default).

health_bind_port.description: Port for health manager to listen on for heartbeat traffic.

heartbeat_receiver_threads.description: Number of threads to handle incoming heartbeat messages.

health_check_interval.description: Seconds between health check probes to backend members.

health_check_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for a response before marking health check failed.

max_retries.description: Number of failed health checks before marking a member 'DOWN'.

min_retry_interval.description: Minimum interval (seconds) between health check retries for same member.
